skills.name: CSS media queries
skills.description: Adapt CSS behavior to viewport or other media conditions.
evidence_criteria: The contributor implements or meaningfully changes a media condition or the styles it controls, with an explainable effect on page behavior.
A media-query mention, unchanged surrounding CSS, or a formatting-only edit is insufficient.

skills.name: CSS Flexbox
skills.description: Control layout through flex containers and their items.
evidence_criteria: The contributor implements or meaningfully changes flex container or item behavior, explaining its effect on alignment, sizing, ordering, or wrapping.
The presence of flex styles elsewhere in the repository, documentation mentions, and formatting-only edits are insufficient.

skills.name: CSS Grid
skills.description: Arrange content using grid tracks, areas, and item placement.
evidence_criteria: The contributor implements or meaningfully changes grid layout behavior through track definitions, areas, placement, or alignment.
A grid-related class name or library dependency alone is insufficient; the changed code must demonstrate the layout behavior.
